meta.name: Is It Cake? Halloween
meta.description: Cake or fake? Trick or treat? Skilled bakers whip up hyperrealistic Halloween cakes in this seasonal special edition of the hit competition series.

videos.title: Cakes to Die For
videos.overview: The competition begins as the bakers craft convincingly creepy dolls, clowns, and ravens.  Guest judges: Pete Holmes, Chelsea Peretti and Ravi V. Patel.

videos.title: Gettin' Witchy with It!
videos.overview: Mikey's fickle "cauldron of destiny" decides which witchy object the bakers must make.  Guest judges: Melissa Joan Hart, Jack McBrayer and Yvonne Orji.

videos.title: Is It Wonka?
videos.overview: The bakers tape into their pure imagination and whip up whimsical Willy Wonka cakes.  Guest judges: Harvey Guillén, Kevin Nealon and Gillian Jacobs.

videos.title: A Scary Good Winner
videos.overview: Vultures, gargoyles and gravestones, oh my!  Which baker will take home the grand prize?  Guest judges: Ron Funches, Rachel Feinstein and Whitney Cummings.

videos.title: Nightmare on Cake Street
videos.overview: The showdown begins as the bakers craft cakes modeled after their favorite spooky decorations. Guest judges: Blippi, Lil Rel Howery and Bianca Belair.

videos.title: Is It Wednesday?
videos.overview: The bakers must craft creepy, kooky cakes that fit right into Wednesday Addams' dorm. Guest judges: Joy Sunday, Hunter Doohan and Isaac Ordonez.

videos.title: Scaring up a Winner
videos.overview: To win the grand prize, the finalists conjure cakes with eerie interactive elements. Guest judges: Kristen Schaal, Paul Scheer and Cedric Yarbrough
